resources.string: No computers yet. Open the app to connect one.
On the computer, open Handsfreely, go to Phones and click \"Add a phone\". Then scan the QR code here.
Point the camera at the QR code in Handsfreely on the computer
Not in range or the program is closed
The computer removed this phone. Remove it here and scan a new QR code.
Remove the computer \"%1$s\"? Connecting again will need a new QR code.
Connecting to \"%1$s\"… If Android asks to pair with the computer, confirm it.
This is not a Handsfreely QR code.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on and try again.
The app has no access to Bluetooth or the camera.
The QR code on the computer has expired or was closed. Show it again.
The computer rejected the connection. Show a new QR code and try again.
Could not reach the computer. Check that Handsfreely is running on it and Bluetooth is on.
Dial, answer and end calls from the computer
Recent calls and the caller\'s number
Scanning the QR code on the computer
Android revokes access only after the app closes. Handsfreely will close, and the connection to the computer stops until you open the app again.
Find Handsfreely in the list and turn battery optimization back on
Open \"Permissions\" and turn off the access you no longer want
SMS on the computer work over Bluetooth without extra access here: when the phone asks whether the computer may access messages, allow it.
Keeps the connection while the screen is off
Full: answer, hold, mute, keypad tones and moving audio work from the computer.
Basic: dialing, answering, declining and hanging up work from the computer. On Windows 11 the computer also handles hold, mute and keypad tones itself.
